Let's add [this PR](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/289) to the agenda. It adds Deneb (4844) types to the beacon API. It needs a sign off before it can be merged.

Would also like to get this merged so we standardize blobs sidecar retrieval via the beacon-API - https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/286. This is useful for writing hive tests.
Worth mentioning that the decouple block and blobs PR has been opened: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3244

For next EIP-4844 call: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-4844-shard-blob-transactions/8430/28
This could allow use of SSZ format for 0-blob transactions in a minimal way.
Closed in favour of https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/722. Added your topic, @etan-status !
